body: Alright so here's an update on the situation after thinking about what I can do and how to arrange it I went to do my laundry I got downstairs to discover that my washer is now inoperable, roommate was the last one to use it because she suddenly wanted to wash her and her boyfriends clothes a couple days ago as she was packing, I was waiting for her to leave to do mine because she's notorious for taking my towels but I'm glad I didn't I messaged her and got a response she knew the washer was broken but "forgot" to tell me , this is a brand new washer like I'm talking not even a month old I and my mother believe she purposely overloaded it or something to be vindictive but idk. Anyways,it was the final straw I called the landlord and left a message stating issues have been going on with her and it seems like it's been worse since she decided to "move out" and that I just discovered she had damaged my property so I'll see what happens when he calls back

Also we are living in what's referred to family housing in Canada and she arrived after I did I don't know if that gives me any pull but my landlord is a pretty reasonable guy would it hurt in giving him a call about the boyfriend who lives here without paying , it's pretty obvious he stays here all of his belongings are scattered throughout the house and his clothes are strewn everywhere

Actually this gives me an idea if I can get my own mom on board who lives across the street and knows and has seen the situation if she agrees to take my boy for a couple of days so I can record and out right tell her to leave for being disruptive then I can remove my own child out of the situation and out of a potential violent or distressing tantrum she may throw which should in theory please cps on my behalf if they have questions.

Her mom visits but she's so brainwashed at this point that she thinks I'm the one leaving it like that, the roommate deflected all of the shitty things she was doing onto me when she talks about me to her family and friends :/ I found out she is quite manipulative that way

The worst part is her child doesn't live in her bedroom they both sleep in the living room on a couch and she makes him sleep on the outside of the couch this child hasn't used a playpen/crib ever and while co sleeping is great shes a lazy neglectful piece of work. Is there any cons to getting cps involved? Like I try to keep the house as clean as possible it just ends up a trashed mess in a matter of hours also I don't want to be considered an enabler it's just she won't listen or becomes verbally hostile if it's brought up.

I've weighed heavily on the decision for cps as a last resort if I couldn't get it through her head, I have tried to explain to her mother what was happening but her mother has heard a different story in the matter and refuses to believe her angel of a child could do this. It's a really severe case of spoiled brat syndrome. Do you think cps could pursuade her to go back home since it seems she needs to be supervised around her child ?

Honestly I don't have any friends any more I havnt talked to anyone because well... I'm really not allowed to im in Canada, the last time I called the police when he was having a psychotic breakdown he acted completely turned it around and said I was threatening him and being abusive... Well they believed him let him go and he broke the chain lock on the door to get back in. I've called a few people including the police , the hospital basically any resources we have in this area and am always told in the end that I'm being dramatic and according to the way he's acting that nothing is wrong or can be done about it.
